correctness.rationale: Complete and independent row-wise maximization reduces the nonlinear norms to 598 finite nonnegative rational matrices. The embedded checker reconstructs all metric balls and confirms 35+17+398+142 strictly subthreshold matrices with rational leading principal minors, exactly one exceptional P3 matrix per type, two reflected exceptions per P4 type, characteristic polynomials, exact Sturm root counts and rational witnesses; Perron simplicity establishes equality classes. Analytic proof explicitly relates those exact calculations to the operator norms, and no claim of infinite-path classification is made.

value.rationale: Centered versus uncentered maximal operators are structurally natural and can differ pointwise even on the three-vertex path; this theorem locates the first *sharp Hilbert-norm* difference at four vertices, with two explicit spectral constants and complete extremizer geometry. The path is the smallest nonstar tree, so the cutoff is not an arbitrary numerical slice.
